# ataila_ai_rate_plan (Data Source)

A tenant's AI rates: its own rates in force today (`rates`; empty when it pays the list rate), scheduled changes, the effective rate per tier with its basis next to the list rate, whether a contract includes metered AI, and the history. Needs a token holding `orders-read-global` or `ai-gateway-read-global` (or an admin key) and platform release 1.0.237 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_ai_rate_plan" "example" {
  tenant_id = "3f0c9a52-4d1e-4b8a-9d61-2f5b7e0c1a44"
}

# What each tier costs the tenant today, and why.
output "effective" {
  value = { for e in data.ataila_ai_rate_plan.example.effective : e.tier => {
    eur_per_1m_input = e.eur_per_1m_input
    basis            = e.basis
  } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) The tenant (`id` of an `ataila_tenant`).

### Read-Only

- `as_of` (String) Today, in the billing time zone.
- `contract` (Attributes) That contract; null when none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contract))
- `contract_included` (Boolean) True while an active contract includes metered AI: it is priced at 0 EUR.
- `currency` (String) Always `EUR`.
- `effective` (Attributes List) What each tier costs the tenant today and why, the list rate beside it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effective))
- `history` (Attributes List) Every plan rate ever set, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--history))
- `rates` (Attributes List) The plan's rates in force today, by tier; empty when the tenant pays the list rate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rates))
- `tenant_name` (String) The tenant's display name.
- `unit` (String) Always `1M tokens`.
- `upcoming` (Attributes List) Scheduled changes of the plan. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--upcoming))

<a id="nestedatt--contract"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contract`

Read-Only:

- `end_date` (String) Its last day; null when open.
- `id` (String) The contract's id.
- `start_date` (String) Its first day.
- `status` (String) Its status, e.g. `active`.


<a id="nestedatt--effective"></a>
### Nested Schema for `effective`

Read-Only:

- `basis` (String) `plan` (its own rate), `list`, `contract_included` (0 EUR) or `none` (not priced).
- `eur_per_1m_input` (Number) EUR per one million input (prompt) tokens.
- `eur_per_1m_output` (Number) EUR per one million output (completion) tokens.
- `list_eur_per_1m_input` (Number) The list rate beside it, for comparison.
- `list_eur_per_1m_output` (Number) The list rate beside it, for comparison.
- `tier` (String) The serving tier, e.g. `general`, `code`, `embed`.
- `valid_from` (String) Since when.


<a id="nestedatt--history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `history`

Read-Only:

- `eur_per_1m_input` (Number) EUR per one million input (prompt) tokens.
- `eur_per_1m_output` (Number) EUR per one million output (completion) tokens.
- `note` (String) The operator's note.
- `set_at` (String) When it was set. RFC 3339 in UTC.
- `set_by` (String) The user who set it (`id` on a user); null when that user no longer exists.
- `tier` (String) The serving tier, e.g. `general`, `code`, `embed`.
- `valid_from` (String) The first billing day the rate applies.
- `valid_to` (String) The last billing day it applies; null while it is open.
